narrative: 把一个画面变成一张海报，眼睛就不可能错过主体。黑暗房间里的一张白脸、白色街道上的一件黑大衣、切开沥青般夜色的灯塔光束：明度对空间的支配力，比家具本身更响亮。
如果这场戏依赖肤色的细腻、食物质感，或混合日光下的对话，这就不是对的工具。如果你压死了中间调，就会失去汗水的质感。
不是每一幅画面都该是一幅木刻版画。影调对比是一种构图方式，并不天然等同于低调布光（Low-Key Lighting）。
你完全可以在正午的硬阳光和深邃阴影下拍出高对比度的画面。低调布光是一种布光比例，
而影调对比构图关乎的是各个质量块所处的位置。
how: 对胜出的一方测光，让另一方的质量有意地跌入暗部或溢出白色。
硬光和黑旗有帮助。逆光轮廓能让一个深色的人物在深色背景前依然可辨。
如果主体是明亮的质量块，就针对高光曝光；如果主体是明亮画面中的暗色质量块，就去掉补光。
提示词：High tonal contrast composition with [Subject] as the lightest or darkest mass, graphic punch, no mid-gray mush.
when: 用它表现夜间追猎、道德的二元对立、图形化的标题画面，以及任何需要在远处也能被一眼读出的场景。不要压死一场信息藏在中间调里的戏。
vs: 低调布光（Low-Key Lighting）是一种以阴影为主导的布光风格。影调对比也可以是一种明亮的图形（白墙配黑色人影）。
剪影（Silhouette）放弃了内部细节。影调对比构图则可能依然保留一只眼睛的细节。
图底关系（Figure-Ground）是更宽泛的“第一眼可读性”分离，包括色彩和焦点的运用。明暗对照法（Chiaroscuro）是用光影进行绘画式的形体塑造，可能不像海报那样平面化。
虚空背景（Void）删除了整个画面场域。影调对比构图依然保留着两个质量块。
examples_film: 《罪恶之城》（Sin City）式的语法把面孔和街道变成墨水与纸张；《灯塔》（The Lighthouse）把明度打磨到盐粒、光束和身体都近乎木刻版画。
两者都首先用明度来构成画面。这是语法，而不是可以照搬的漫画分格套路。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是浑浊的中灰色。破绽是一张脸、一堵墙和一件外套全都处于同一个明度区间之内。
修正方法：选定最亮或最暗的质量块，用遮光旗、曝光或服装把其余部分推向别处。

faq.q: 电影中的影调对比（Tonal Contrast）是什么？
faq.a: 它是一种由强烈的明暗质量块构成的构图，主体是其中一极。画面读起来像一幅图形。中灰色的细节被削减，让明度而不是杂乱的细节来主导画面。

faq.q: 影调对比（Tonal Contrast）与低调布光（Low-Key Lighting）有何区别？
faq.a: 低调布光是一种布光比例：补光很少，阴影占主导。影调对比关乎的是明暗如何作为形状存在。一条正午的街道，有硬阳光和深邃阴影，也可以是高对比度的，而不必是夜间室内场景。一间低调布光的房间里，依然可以有一张柔和、细节丰富的脸。

faq.q: 什么时候该用影调对比（Tonal Contrast）？
faq.a: 当镜头应该读起来像一张海报时使用它：夜晚、道德的分裂、图形化标题、一个剪影般的人物。不要压死那些需要展现肌肤、食物或混合对话细节的场景。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写影调对比（Tonal Contrast）的提示词？
faq.a: 明确两极。示例：High tonal contrast composition with [Subject] as the lightest or darkest mass, graphic punch, no mid-gray mush。说明主体属于哪一极。禁止均匀的照明。

narrative: Make a poster out of a frame and the eye cannot miss the subject. A white face in a black room, a black coat on a white street, a lighthouse beam cutting tar: value owns space more loudly than furniture.
It is the wrong tool for a scene that lives in complexion, food, or mixed daylight conversation. If you crush the mids, you lose the sweat.
Not every picture should be a woodcut. Tonal contrast is composition, not automatically Low-Key Lighting lighting.
You can shoot high contrast at noon with hard sun and deep shade. Low-key is a lighting ratio.
Contrast composition is where the masses sit.
how: Meter for the winner. Let the other mass fall off or blow, on purpose.
Hard light and a dark flag help. A backlight rim can keep a dark figure readable on dark.
Expose for highlights if the subject is the bright mass. Kill fill if the subject is the dark mass on a bright field.
Prompt: High tonal contrast composition with [Subject] as the lightest or darkest mass, graphic punch, no mid-gray mush.
when: Use it for night hunts, moral binaries, graphic titles, and any beat that should read at a distance. Do not crush a scene whose information lives in the midtones.
vs: Low-Key Lighting is a lighting style with dominant shadow. Tonal contrast can also be a bright graphic (white wall, black figure).
Silhouette gives up interior detail. Contrast composition may still keep an eye.
Figure-Ground is the broader first-read split, including color and focus. Chiaroscuro is the painterly modeling of form with light and dark, which may be less poster-flat.
Void deletes the field. Contrast still has two masses.
examples_film: Sin City language turns faces and streets into ink and paper. The Lighthouse grinds value until salt, beam, and body are almost woodcut.
Both make composition out of value first. Grammar, not a comic-panel kit to steal.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is muddy mid-grey. The tell is a face, a wall, and a coat all sitting in the same value band.
The fix is to pick the lightest or darkest mass and send the rest away with flags, exposure, or costume.

faq.q: What is tonal contrast in film?
faq.a: It is a composition built from strong light and dark masses, with the subject as one of those poles. The picture reads as a graphic. Mid-grey detail is reduced so value, not clutter, owns the frame.

Low-key is a lighting ratio: little fill, dominant shadow. Tonal contrast is where light and dark sit as shapes. A noon street with hard sun and deep shade can be high contrast without being a night interior. A low-key room can still be a soft, detailed face.

faq.q: When should I use tonal contrast?
faq.a: Use it when the shot should read as a poster: night, moral split, graphic title, a figure as a cut-out. Do not crush scenes that need skin, food, or mixed conversation detail.

faq.q: How do I prompt tonal contrast for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name the poles. Example: High tonal contrast composition with [Subject] as the lightest or darkest mass, graphic punch, no mid-gray mush. Say which one they are. Ban even illumination.
